name: FTLab GDK101 Gamma Radiation Sensor Module
description: The **GDK101** sensor platform allows you to use your GDK101 sensor to monitor radiation levels at your place.

config_entries.label: Address
config_entries.description: Manually specify the I²C address of the sensor. Defaults to `0x18` (`A0` and `A1` shorted). The address is made up using the state of `A0` as bit 1 and the state of `A1` as bit 2, so a total of four addresses is possible.

config_entries.label: Update Interval
config_entries.description: Manually defined update interval of sensor. Defaults to 60s.
